title: the preview of a one-line settings file prints one fallback line instead of the whole file
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup hook, defect N-17): jitso registers its guard in the project's .claude/settings.json without clobbering anything
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-17, setup hook). A compact settings file is one line, so its diff would be that whole line, secrets included (AGENTS.md rule 1). The preview of a sensitive file whose existing content has fewer than three lines prints only `(.claude/settings.json: the file is compact JSON; its changes are not shown)`. The dry run still exits 0 and writes nothing.

stdout: (.claude/settings.json: the file is compact JSON; its changes are not shown)

stdout.regex: jitso setup hook: dry run, nothing written\n$
